meta.name: alterlab-scikit-bio
meta.description: Analyze biological data with scikit-bio — sequence analysis and alignments, phylogenetic trees, alpha/beta diversity metrics (including UniFrac), ordination (PCoA), PERMANOVA statistics, and FASTA/Newick I/O. Use for microbiome and community-ecology analysis — computing diversity, distance matrices, and ordination from feature tables. Part of the AlterLab Academic Skills suite.

copy.tagline: 分析微生物组与群落生态数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在做微生物组或群落生态学的生物信息分析
copy.tagline_en: Analyze microbiome and community ecology data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are doing bioinformatics analysis for microbiome or community ecology

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能用 scikit-bio 分析生物数据，包括序列处理、比对、进化树、多样性计算、排序分析和统计检验，并读写 FASTA、Newick 等格式。
howto.when: 当你提出生物信息学相关需求，如处理 DNA/RNA 序列、计算微生物多样性、构建进化树或进行群落生态统计分析时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 scikit-bio 计算这个 OTU 表的 Shannon 多样性。
对这两个 DNA 序列做局部比对。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can analyze biological data using scikit-bio: sequence manipulation, alignment, phylogenetic trees, diversity metrics, ordination, statistical tests, and I/O for FASTA, Newick, etc.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you request bioinformatics tasks such as processing DNA/RNA sequences, computing microbial diversity, building phylogenetic trees, or performing community ecology statistics.

say_en.text: Compute Shannon diversity for this OTU table using scikit-bio.
say_en.note: Claude will call alpha_diversity to compute the Shannon index.

say_en.text: Perform a local alignment of these two DNA sequences.
say_en.note: Claude will use pair_align for Smith-Waterman alignment.

say_en.text: Read this Newick tree and compute Robinson-Foulds distance to another tree.
say_en.note: Claude will read the tree and call compare_rfd.
